translation:
In injury, when there is an exterior evil (表邪) accompanying it, the pulse must be floating and tight, and the signs are fever and pain of the body. In those whose form and qi are replete, one should use Wind-Dispersing and Toxin-Defeating Powder (疏風敗毒散); in those whose form and qi are deficient, one should use Modified Jiajia Powder (加味交加散), or Notopterygium and Frankincense Decoction (羌活乳香湯) to disperse it. <ins>Wind-Dispersing and Toxin-Defeating Powder (疏風敗毒散)</ins>
Dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍藥), cooked rehmannia (熟地黃), notopterygium (羌活), duhuo (獨活), platycodon (桔梗), bitter orange (枳殼), bupleurum (柴胡), white poria (白茯苓), angelica dahurica (白芷), licorice (甘草), perilla (紫蘇), tangerine peel (陳皮), cyperus (香附)
Above, decoct with fresh ginger (生薑) and raw rehmannia (生地黃), add wine and take together.
